notes:
User is organizing an overcrowded shoe closet. Chosen system: sort by shoe type, then by color within each group; store out-of-season shoes in bins. They are also considering frequency/occasion organization but have not adopted it.

Shoes and care:
- New black Converse Chuck Taylor All Stars: worn six times total (most recently running errands yesterday). Very comfortable and versatile with jeans and dresses. Needs regular gentle cleaning, protection, and possibly waterproofing spray for mud/rain. Choose a product compatible with the upper material, test on an inconspicuous area, follow instructions, and consider breathability/appearance. Crepe Protect, Nikwax, or compatible Scotchgard were previously suggested; verify suitability for the exact material before buying.
- Brown leather boots: heel is coming loose and may break. User plans to find a trusted local cobbler using online reviews and recommendations from friends; should compare experience with leather repair, process, turnaround time, quote, and warranty. User plans to buy a cedar shoe tree sized for the boots to maintain shape and absorb moisture; use only when dry. They also plan to buy a leather-specific cleaning kit, ensuring compatibility with the boot leather (not suede/nubuck unless applicable), ideally containing gentle cleaner, conditioner, protector, brush, and cloth. Saphir, Kiwi, and Lexol were suggested. Ongoing care includes gentle cleaning, conditioning, waterproofing, and careful storage; test products first.
- White Adidas Superstars: worn to the gym last week and became dirty/scuffed. User scrubbed for 20 minutes with a toothbrush and soap; future cleaning should use gentler methods and appropriate sneaker products, tested on an inconspicuous area, avoiding harsh chemicals/excess water and air-drying away from heat/direct sunlight.

User is considering Vans Old Skool sneakers and asked whether they are comfortable and worth the investment. Advice given: generally comfortable, durable, breathable, casual, and stylish, but they should try them on for fit, choose material/color carefully, and maintain them regularly. User appreciates practical, step-by-step advice.
